description: Tests first: external ID collision across connectors, ambiguous identity fails closed. Preserve person-bound actor; scoped mapping for authors and membership events. Extend People identity resolution; do not infer grants from usernames/email.

comments.text: Human decision: link existing PersonChannel identities to the sole connector for their provider during migration (current ChannelConfig schema enforces one connector per provider); do not silently match usernames/emails or permit ambiguous issuer mapping. Maintain person-bound actors. For future multi-config, scoped identity must be unambiguous; reconcile PersonMerger and existing BO-owned channels. Action reuse: extend People/IdentityResolver and current channel identity schema, not a parallel global matcher. Tests first: legacy link, same external ID on different configs after uniqueness expansion, forged config rejection, concurrent first ingress; downstream event provenance trusted only via Channels boundary.

title: [#768] Trusted connector-scoped author identity
